**All Out (2021)** was an **All Elite Wrestling (AEW)** pay-per-view held on **September 5, 2021**, at the **NOW Arena** in **Hoffman Estates, Illinois** (the Chicago area).

It was one of the most historically significant AEW shows ever, mainly because it featured:
- **CM Punk’s first pro wrestling match in over 7 years**
- **Adam Cole’s AEW debut**
- **Bryan Danielson’s AEW debut**
- a major **title change** and several big storyline developments

## Basic event info
- **Promotion:** AEW
- **Date:** September 5, 2021
- **Venue:** NOW Arena
- **Location:** Hoffman Estates, Illinois
- **Theme/song:** AEW’s usual event branding at the time; the show is most remembered for its crowd reaction and surprise appearances rather than a specific theme song

## Why it mattered
All Out 2021 is often remembered as one of the biggest “moment” shows in modern wrestling because AEW packed it with:
- a huge **CM Punk comeback match**
- major **debut/surprise appearances**
- a strong main event scene
- the kind of “hot crowd” atmosphere that made AEW feel like it was peaking creatively and commercially

## Notable matches and results

### CM Punk vs. Darby Allin
- **Winner:** CM Punk
- This was Punk’s first match since leaving wrestling in 2014.
- It was a big emotional comeback for him, and the Chicago crowd was extremely loud for it.

### AEW World Championship: Kenny Omega (c) vs. Christian Cage
- **Winner:** Kenny Omega
- Omega retained the title.
- The finish led into one of the show’s biggest post-match angles.

### AEW World Tag Team Championship Steel Cage Match:
**The Young Bucks (c) vs. Lucha Brothers**
- **Winner:** Lucha Brothers
- The Lucha Brothers won the AEW Tag Team Titles in a steel cage match.
- This was one of the most praised matches on the card.

### AEW Women’s World Championship:
**Britt Baker (c) vs. Kris Statlander**
- **Winner:** Britt Baker
- Baker retained the title.

### TNT Championship:
**Miro (c) vs. Eddie Kingston**
- **Winner:** Miro
- Miro retained.

### Jon Moxley vs. Satoshi Kojima
- **Winner:** Jon Moxley

### Women’s Casino Battle Royale
- **Winner:** Ruby Soho
- Ruby Soho’s win was a major surprise and a huge debut moment for her in AEW.
- She earned a title shot by winning the match.

## Major debuts and post-match surprises

### Adam Cole debut
After the AEW World Title match, **Adam Cole** appeared and shocked the crowd by joining the AEW side of the wrestling world.

### Bryan Danielson debut
Not long after Adam Cole’s appearance, **Bryan Danielson** made his own surprise AEW debut.
- This was one of the biggest wrestling debuts in years.
- The show ended with the implication that AEW had just added two of the biggest free agents in the industry.

## Crowd and reception
- The Chicago-area crowd was one of the loudest AEW crowds ever.
- The audience reaction to CM Punk, Ruby Soho, Adam Cole, and Bryan Danielson was massive.
- The event is widely viewed as one of AEW’s most important and most talked-about shows.

## Business impact
- The show was reported to have done **very strong pay-per-view numbers**, among the biggest AEW had done at that point.
- It helped solidify AEW’s momentum in 2021 as a major wrestling company with real mainstream buzz.

## Legacy
All Out 2021 is remembered for:
- **CM Punk’s full-time wrestling return**
- **the debuts of Adam Cole and Bryan Danielson**
- **the Lucha Brothers’ tag title win**
- being one of AEW’s most newsworthy and exciting PPVs

3. a **“why this event was so important” timeline**.
